# Working in Claude, after the app

Sent before Session 3. Nothing here is needed for Sessions 1 or 2.

By now the app has your Founder Brain, your voice, your 30 pieces and your engine. This is the other half: getting Claude on your own machine to use all of that, and to talk to the tools that actually send things.

The app is where the work gets made. Claude is where you run it, from Session 3 onwards and for as long as you keep going after Atlanta.

## Why bother, when the app already works

Three reasons, and if none of them matter to you, skip this until after Atlanta.

**It can reach your tools.** The app writes your posts. Claude, with the connectors below, can put them into GoHighLevel for you.

**It remembers you.** The more you work in one place, the more it knows how you write and what you have already tried.

**It is yours.** Your Apollo account, your GoHighLevel account, your machine. Nothing here goes through us.

## 1. Get Claude on your machine

Download Claude for desktop and sign in.

Sign in on the account you will bring to Atlanta and stay on it. Connectors are set up per account, and switching later means doing all of this twice.

This needs a paid Claude plan. That is separate from the API key you put into the app, and having one does not give you the other.

## 2. Install the toolkit

In the desktop app, click the + button next to the message box, choose Plugins, and add the marketplace `Philm-moxywolf/Atlanta`. Then install `growth-engine` from it.

This is what teaches Claude the rules this programme runs on: your track, your voice, and the two mistakes that cost the most.

If it does not appear, quit and reopen the app, then try again. That fixes it nearly every time. If it still does not, post in the Slack channel rather than losing an evening.

## 3. Connect Apollo, if you sell to businesses

Apollo has a connector you add to your Claude account. It is a few clicks and there is nothing to paste.

Once it is on, Claude can search for people, get their email addresses, and build a sequence in your Apollo account.

Skip this entirely if you sell to consumers. Apollo is not part of your track.

## 4. Connect GoHighLevel

GoHighLevel has its own connector too. Their guide walks through it:

https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005741-how-to-setup-and-use-the-highlevel-mcp-server

Once it is on, Claude can post your content, read your contacts, and check what has gone out. This is the one that saves the most time, because it is the difference between reading your 30 pieces and publishing them.

Do this after the clinic on 23 September, not before. You will not have a GoHighLevel account to connect until then.

## 5. Give Claude your work

Claude cannot see inside the app. It has no idea who you are until you show it.

In the app, open **Files** and press the button that downloads everything. You get a folder called `growth-engine`.

Unzip it. You now have a folder called `growth-engine`, with your Brain and everything else inside it.

**Put it inside another folder, and open that one in Claude.** Make a folder called something like `launchhouse`, drop `growth-engine` inside it, and point Claude at `launchhouse`. Not at `growth-engine` itself.

That sounds fussy and it is the one step people get wrong. Claude looks for a folder called `growth-engine` inside wherever you opened. Open `growth-engine` directly and it looks inside itself, finds nothing, and tells you that you have not started yet.

That is the whole trick. With the folder open, Claude reads your Brain and writes in your voice. Without it, you get writing that could belong to anybody, delivered with total confidence, and that is worse than nothing.

**Download it again whenever you rebuild something in the app.** The folder is a copy, not a live link, and a stale copy is how you end up publishing last month's offer.

## What to say once it is set up

Plain English, the same as in the app. There is nothing to memorise.

| What you want | Say something like |
|---|---|
| Publish this week's posts | "post the next five pieces from my content file to GoHighLevel" |
| Find more people to write to | "find me twenty more people like the ones in my people folder" |
| Write to them | "write first lines for these five, in my voice" |
| Check what went out | "what did I publish last week" |
| Pick up where you left off | "where am I up to" |

If nothing happens, say it again in different words. That costs ten seconds and it is not you doing it wrong.

## One thing that changes, and it matters

Inside the app, the rules are enforced. A file that invents a number or automates a cold DM is held before it is saved, and you are told why.

**Out here, they are advice.** Claude has your tools and your accounts. It can send. Nothing stops it.

That is correct, because it is your business and your money, and you should not need our permission to send an email. But it means the two rules below are now yours to hold rather than ours.

**Never automate cold DMs on Instagram.** Sending opening messages to people who have not messaged you first gets accounts restricted, and that is not something you can undo. Yours go out by hand, spread out, from your own account.

**Never let a number you cannot back up reach a buyer.** If somebody asks where a figure came from, the answer has to be something you said. If it is real, put it in your Founder Brain so it is on the record. If it is not, take it out.

Read what it writes before it goes anywhere. You would do that with an assistant on their first week, and this is the same thing.

## What this costs

Nothing new. The connectors are free, the plugin is free, and Apollo and GoHighLevel are the accounts you already have.

Your Claude plan is the one cost, and you are on it for the desktop app anyway.

Post in the Slack channel. Do not wait for the session.
